title: Assam Chakka Bandh From November 20: 48-Hour Statewide Transport Strike Announced

ai.summary: Assam transport unions announced a 48-hour statewide strike from November 20-22, 2026, demanding a 70% fare hike and social security measures due to rising costs and unaddressed grievances.

facts.quote: Guwahati: Assam's transport owners' and workers' associations have announced a 48-hour statewide chakka bandh from November 20 to November 22, 2026, protesting against rising operating costs and unresolved demands.
Their principal financial demand is a 70% increase in fares. The associations argue that the last fare revision took place in 2019, while fuel and spare-part costs have continued to rise.
The associations have raised concerns about the financial conditions of transport owners and workers and are seeking action from the Assam Transport Department.
